text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun has managed to leave
a brilliant
mark on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've navigated our way through her

all-important first three years, and
today, she's
her usual energetic self...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It's time for takeoff! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, c'mon! Why did Brian get first
again?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. You've lost your edge.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Blegh, you're such a meanie! I want a
rematch!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
No way. One will have to be enough. ☆
You're
racing against me next,
Mayano. ★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's right!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Heh. Okay then, Marvey! Let's race! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting to hear you say
that. ☆★

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...How childish.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Then what does that make you?
You're the
one gettin' all worked up
about beating Maya.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... Ama.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You're no different. I saw you challenge
her too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! The difference is I'm gonna win
when I
take her on one-on-one!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Right over your head...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Phew... ☆ I think that's all the partner
running for
today...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You haven't run with me or Nature yet!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No thank you. Count me out. I'll leave
the running
to you youngsters...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're not fooling anyone! I can see that
you're
practically shaking with
excitement right now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Haha! ☆ Guess that means we have to
race! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wait, you guys—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. Hey, you. Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I guess her schedule's still packed, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...What are you so happy about? She's
the one
who asked to race me again.
choice_data_list: マヤノは人気者だから
choice_data_list_en: Mayano is so popular, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Whatever.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm tired today anyway. Tell her I want
the first
match tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph... I look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What's going on?! Trainer, are you
cheating on
me?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's enough running! It's time to
go on a
date!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Don't you "huh" me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm done with partner running, and I've
already
finished all my other plans for
today.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It'll be a quick one. Just put me in a
good mood!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay! Love ya, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let's meet at the school gates in ten
minutes! Do
you copy?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Mayano Top Gun and I go on
a date...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haha! We're just in time! Nice!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. ☆ It's nice every once in a while!
choice_data_list: まさか夜まで付き合わされるとは……
choice_data_list_en: I never thought I'd be dragged along until nightfall...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Especially now that I've grown up a
little!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Are you sure you didn't mean to
say "a
lot"?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. What am I gonna do with you?
But it's
okay 'cause...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become an even more twinkly

grown-up lady!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: By the way...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
This is definitely where I twinkle the
most.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone runs their hearts out—and
sure, I
might lose to them sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But it's the most fun I've ever had! It's so
exciting
and makes my heart pound!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's moments like these that make me
really feel
like I'm twinkly!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yep! So...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I want you to help me sparkle even more
brightly
from now on!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And, y'know... I still have a lot of stuff I
wanna do!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Like going on a beach date or visiting an

amusement park at night!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And I wanna run in all the different races
I haven't
experienced yet!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I agree! ☆
choice_data_list: マヤノなら全部できるよ
choice_data_list_en: You can do it all, Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: After all, I have you by my side!
